pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with distinct serrated or 'toothed' pixel-level gradients along the margins. The patches exhibit a high degree of edge angularity where the dark tawny pigment meets the lighter interstitial regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored pathways with relatively uniform pixel width across the flank. The network topology is characterized by frequent tri-nodal junctions forming a consistent reticulated grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, consisting of short, upright hairs with low-amplitude vertical projections.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal midline at the cranial-shoulder transition.
